subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB432
title: Instructs the forester, or a forest protective association or agency that is under contract or agreement with the State Board of Forestry for the protection of forestland against fire, and whose protection area is or may be affected by a fire on nearby federal lands, to take certain actions to address the fire.
headline: SB 432 did not pass

claims.text: SB 432 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 432 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
